_note: Shared between Thwart Android and Thwart Web: both test suites read this file unchanged. Spec: docs/spec/synergie-et-draft.md. Texts are MarvelCDB real_text; identities list the printed traits of every face.

alter_ego_only_psionic._note: Invented for the hero-only rule: the trait is on the alter ego alone.

rocket_raccoon.text: Play only if your identity has the [[guardian]] trait. Interrupt: When Rocket Raccoon attacks a minion, he gets +3 ATK for that attack. That attack gains overkill.

moon_girl.text: Play only if your identity has the [[champion]] or [[genius]] trait. Response: After Moon Girl enters play, draw 1 card.

elixir.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] trait. Action: Exhaust Elixir → heal 2 damage from a character.

yellow_jacket.text: Play only if you have the [[Avenger]] trait. Response: After Yellow Jacket enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

shield_deputy.text: Play only if your identity has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait. Action: Exhaust S.H.I.E.L.D. Deputy → give an enemy a stun.

psi_bow_attack.text: Play only if your hero has the [[PSIONIC]] trait. Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy.

helicarrier.text: Resource: Exhaust Helicarrier → generate a [wild] resource for any player.

martinex_bonus_only.text: Reduce the cost to play Martinex by 1 if your identity has the [[Guardian]] trait. Response: After Martinex enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

spycraft_out_of_scope.text: Play only if you control a [[Spy]] character. Action: Exhaust Spycraft → look at the top card of the encounter deck.
spycraft_out_of_scope.unrecognised: Play only if you control a [[Spy]] character.
